name: Audio Embed Field
description: Provides a field type for displaying audio from 3rd party providers such as SoundCloud, plus a Custom URL provider for HTML5 audio files. Turns a pasted URL into an embedded player, thumbnail or Colorbox modal, and ships a core Media source submodule.

suggests.drupal/colorbox: Enables the 'Colorbox Modal' formatter (thumbnail that launches the player in a modal). Optional; the module works without it.

provides_plugin_types: AudioEmbedProvider (Plugin/audio_embed_field/Provider) — the provider plugin type, gathered by the audio_embed_field.provider_manager service; ships SoundCloud and CustomUrl implementations
field formatters: audio_embed_field_audio (Audio), audio_embed_field_thumbnail (Thumbnail), audio_embed_field_colorbox (Colorbox Modal)
project_description:
Audio Embed Field creates a simple field type that allows you to embed audio.

SoundCloud and Custom URL plugins are provided with the module. Submodules are also provided for integration with Drupal core media and media_entity. Audio embed field simply creates an embedded audio player to play attached media.

Requirements: for the audio_embed_media module you need media_entity; for the audio_embed_media_core module you need core media. The base module requires field and image from core. The module can make use of colorbox but it is not required.

When you add fields, select the providers you want to use, including Custom URL and SoundCloud. If using SoundCloud you need to obtain a Client ID (and, in 11.1.x, a Client Secret for OAuth 2.1) from the SoundCloud Developers site: https://developers.soundcloud.com/ . You may override the Twig template files in the /templates folder in your theme.
